GamesHillthornVersionNintendo SwitchEditionDigitalBlood, Use of Drugs and Alcohol, ViolenceLoadingNintendo Switch 2 Compatibility InformationSupported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch. A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken. A World in CardsEvery eerie and unsettling detail of Hillthorn's story is revealed entirely through Clue cards, which can be Investigated, Explored or in some instances Talked to in your search to get closer to truth behind the disappearance.You Are an OutsiderYou've been tasked to find a missing person, though it’ll take some finesse to draw information from the locals, who seem reluctant to share details with someone outside their flock.Time is in Short SupplyThe clock is ticking. There are too many threads to follow and too little time. Something seems keen on letting you revisit untrodden paths, but at what cost? Features• Discover a strange mountain and uncover its secrets.• Card-based investigation with no dialogue.• The clock ticks with every action.• Multiple endings to discover• Knowledge as progression.• No Generative AISoftware description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 417 MBNintendo Switch 2: 417 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite.
